correctness.rationale: Zhao identifies the generic residual-gerbe fiber with \([A/(A[2]\times\{\pm1\})]\) and gives the fixed equation \(2x=T\). Each of the \(16\) elements with inversion has a \(16\)-point \(A[2]\)-torsor as fixed locus; its quotient is one \(B(\mathbf Z/2)\) sector and its tangent eigenvalues are \((-1,-1)\), hence age \(1\). The identity-sector invariants and \(16\) shifted point sectors give \(h_{\mathrm{CR}}^{1,1}=20\) and Betti numbers \((1,22,1)\). Exact arithmetic was replayed in the embedded verifier.
